---

## Brand Purpose & Mission
Jegatheesh Web Studio was founded with a single mission: to empower photographers and visual creators to own their digital assets. While platforms like Instagram and Facebook are useful for micro-content, they suffer from algorithm volatility, heavy image compression, and limited lead conversion mechanisms. Jegatheesh Web Studio builds custom-coded, ultra-fast websites that showcase high-resolution photography without speed degradation and provide high-converting lead generation channels (WhatsApp booking, structured inquiry forms, direct calls).

---

## Core Service Catalog

### 1. Photographer Portfolio Website Design
- **Description:** Custom professional portfolio websites built for photographers — fast-loading, mobile-friendly sites that showcase your photography, tell your story, and make it easy for clients to reach you.
- **Key Features:**
  - High-performance photo galleries with zero compression blur.
  - Mobile-responsive layout for smooth client browsing.
  - On-page search engine optimization (SEO).
  - Direct WhatsApp & email client inquiry triggers.
